title: Sunday · the dock, after
logline: The dock six days after the Fourth: spent tubes in the planks' gaps, the shack shut, the bay flat. Nobody. The Sunday is the cleaning-up the strip never shows anyone doing.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the dock's planks close, spent firework tubes wedged in the gaps, gull droppings.
